summary: The speaker argues that the historical precedent of state-supported churches has led to a mentality where giving and tithing are viewed as optional, yet this mindset is spiritually problematic for Christians who are called to serve the Lord with all they have. He emphasizes that financial resources are sanctified through the Incarnation and belong to God, urging believers to shift from a restricted, minimum-giving approach to one of true generosity where every expense serves the Lord. The speaker shares his personal experience of deciding to tithe with his wife, noting that this commitment allowed them to trust that God would provide for their needs.
